newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal announces dates of EDP sale.
newsitem.headline: Portugal announces dates of EDP sale.

text.p: Bookbuilding for the planned partial privatisation of state electricity concern EDP will begin on May 26, with the final bourse session set for June 16, the Portuguese Finance Ministry said on Monday.
Pre-registration for investors seeking to reserve shares will begin on May 26, with the public offer to sell (OPV) starting on June 9.
The government initially plans to sell 25 percent of EDP-Electricidade de Portugal but the amount could rise to 49 percent if demand is sufficient.
Either way, it would be the largest privatisation yet carried out in Portugal. EDP is valued at between 1.4 trillion and 1.7 trillion escudos, according to government officials.
